description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and a value labeled as 'BPC'. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps (x10³)", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 50, is in units of 10³, and has tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "BPC", has a linear scale, ranges from 1.2 to 2.0, and has tick labels at intervals of 0.25. A yellow line, marked with circular data points, represents "XMoE Validating"; it begins at approximately 1.95 at x=0 and decreases to approximately 1.25 at x=10, then continues to fluctuate between approximately 1.23 and 1.28 until x=50. A magenta line, marked with triangular data points, represents "SimSMoE Validating"; it begins at approximately 1.95 at x=0 and decreases to approximately 1.23 at x=10, then continues to fluctuate between approximately 1.19 and 1.26 until x=50.
